plugin_desc: Lantronix SLC console-server SNMP collection for devices under Lantronix PEN 244 (LANTRONIX-SLC). The shared ConsoleServer SNMP floor supplies MIB-II uptime and IF-MIB 64-bit HC interface traffic. This child template adds verified chassis leaves: slcSystemInternalTemp as device_temperature_celsius (9999 read-error values are dropped), slcDevPowerSupplyA/B as psu_a_status/psu_b_status normalized conservatively to 1=healthy and 2=fault (notInstalled on B is not treated as fault) and rolled up to device_psu_state, plus optional slcConnNumber as active_sessions. Optional per-port sensor temperature and humidity DisplayString columns are collected when numeric; empty values are skipped. CPU and memory percentages are not faked because LANTRONIX-SLC-MIB does not expose stable shared CPU or memory gauges.
name: ConsoleServer

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Lantronix SLC internal chassis temperature in degrees Celsius, read from slcSystemInternalTemp. A sentinel 9999 read-error value is dropped and not reported.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Lantronix SLC power-supply state rolled up from slcDevPowerSupplyA/B, normalized to 1=healthy and 2=fault. notInstalled on supply B is not treated as a fault.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: psu_a_status
metrics.description: Status of Lantronix SLC power supply A from slcDevPowerSupplyA, normalized to 1 (healthy/up) or 2 (fault/down).

metrics.name: psu_b_status
metrics.description: Status of Lantronix SLC power supply B from slcDevPowerSupplyB, normalized to 1 (healthy/up or notInstalled) or 2 (fault/down).

metrics.name: active_sessions
metrics.description: Number of active console connections on the Lantronix SLC, read from optional slcConnNumber (connections table row count).

metrics.name: lantronix_port_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Optional per-port sensor temperature in degrees Celsius from slcDevPortCfgDevTemperature. Empty or non-numeric values on ports without a sensor are skipped.

metrics.name: lantronix_port_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Optional per-port sensor relative humidity percent from slcDevPortCfgDevHumidity. Empty or non-numeric values on ports without a sensor are skipped.
